story.title: Indian Companies Rush to Buy Cyber Insurance as AI Agent Risks and Rogue Chatbots Create New Liabilities
story.summary: Indian companies are increasingly purchasing cyber insurance policies to protect against AI-specific risks, including AI agents acting autonomously in harmful ways and chatbots providing incorrect or dangerous information. Insurers are redesigning their underwriting models to assess AI exposure, marking a significant shift in how corporate India manages technological liability. The global AI insurance market is projected for substantial growth, and India's uptake signals that boardrooms are treating AI risk as a mainstream financial concern rather than a fringe scenario.
